mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, here is today's balanced dish on the weather, featuring 65 degrees and moderate rain at Firemans Park. The moon is currently in its first quarter phase, and if you are around at 8:27 PM tonight, look toward the northwest over Middleton and Verona High School to catch a 4-minute view of the International Space Station as it travels toward the northeast near Home Depot.

City updates include the start of chip sealing road treatments on September 23, which will affect areas including Cross Country Road and the Liberty Business Park, so please drive carefully. Additionally, the Plan Commission is reviewing various development projects on October 5.

There is plenty to do in our community, starting with live music today at Baileys Run Vineyard and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, the Sugar River Fire and Smoke BBQ Festival kicks off in Paoli, and the Dane County Farmers Market will be open at the Capitol.
In a look at our weekly report, on September 3, a 33-year-old Madison man was arrested for O W I, second offence, after a vehicle crash on Shooting Star Road.
The Verona Culvers is currently open until 10:30 PM, though please be advised that the location is currently closed for a scheduled remodel.
